equipment.name: Drakescale Plate
equipment.desc: Attacks against this model reduce their AP by 1.

equipment.name: Hydra's Teeth
equipment.desc: One Bolt weapon of the model gains the "Explosive", "Poison(2+)" and "Seeking" abilities.

equipment.name: Icon of Insurrection
equipment.desc: If this model is attached to a unit of Cultists, they both gain the "Blind Rage" and "Furious Charge" abilities.

equipment.name: Mindveil
equipment.desc: The model and its attached unit gain the "Deflect" ability. Additionally, they may always move +1D3" with any kind of order.

equipment.name: I am Alpharius
equipment.desc: If at least one character model from the same Army Organisation Plan is alive at the end of the last battle round, the army scores the "Protect the Warlord" secondary objective and the enemy can't score the "Slay the Warlord" secondary objective. Unique.

equipment.name: Hidden compartments
equipment.desc: <Cultist> models embarked within this model occupy only half the capacity they normally would.

equipment.name: Improved jammer
equipment.desc: Once per game during your Reinforcement Phase, before players perform their reinforcement rolls, this model can gain this ability: "Units can not arrive from reserves within 12" of this unit. If units would scatter within range of this ability, they are returned to reserves". This ability lasts until the next Reinforcement Phase.
